To create a transcript, microphone audio and connection information such as your IP address are sent over encrypted HTTPS or WSS to OpenAI or the compatible online speech provider you configured. Precision mode sends the recording after you stop; realtime mode sends audio chunks while you speak. This app does not retain an audio file, and inserts text only after you review it. Provider processing and retention follow that provider’s terms. Continue to accept this transmission and proceed to Android’s microphone permission.

The audio file you choose (up to 24 MB and 60 minutes) and connection information such as your IP address are sent over encrypted HTTPS to OpenAI or the compatible online speech provider you configured to create a speaker-separated transcript. This app does not retain a copy of the file. Provider processing and retention follow that provider’s terms. Continue only if you have permission to upload every speaker’s voice.
